ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 30% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in scratches and barnacles against a 70% low-intensity (black) base surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is predominantly low-intensity black. Mid-to-distal regions of both lobes are populated by dense, chaotic white linear streaks. High-intensity irregular geometric clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle estimated at 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; moderate frequency of 10-12 peaks per lobe with amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels relative to the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge shows an initial concave transition from the notch, leading into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent high-contrast clusters of irregular white/grey pixel groups (barnacles) at both distal tips. Scattered individual high-intensity circular dots are visible across the dark interior surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering a majority of the lobe surfaces, with higher density in the mid-sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation at both lateral tips and pervasive linear scarring across the entire visible ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional density of linear abrasions creating a highly textured white-on-black surface pattern in the lateral-central regions of both lobes.
